thread:
Maya R: Heads up — new vault policy rollout made it into prod at ~07:58 UTC, now dozens of prod-ml boot pods stuck with 403s grabbing agent creds and model keys.
Raj: confirmed. started right after the rotation job. nodes fail to fetch keystore tokens -> can't decrypt model blobs -> fail join GPU pool.
Carlos: paste from one bootstrap log:
```
2026-03-23T07:59:12Z bootstrap error: vault auth failed
status=403 url=https://vault.prod.internal/v1/secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token
policy="keystore-tight-2026-03-23"
reason="path not found or permission denied"
```
Ben P: yeah that policy tightened paths to "infra/keystore/nodes/*" and we inadvertently removed the artifact-service role from the allowlist. my bad — I pushed the change.
Steve (security): we scoped the rotation to reduce blast radius across namespaces, but missed the service account mapping for artifact-service. rolling rollback now.
Maya R: note this is causing autoscaler churn: new nodes spawn in us-west-2 then fail join -> cost alert firing for excess on-demand GPU spins. ops-bot posted cost spike at 08:14.
ops-bot: Cost alert: GPU spend +130% vs previous hour (us-west-2).
Nina (compliance): quick question — any chance audit exporter was disabled during rotation? we need logs for the window.
Ben P: I disabled audit-shipper during the rollout to avoid noisy logs then forgot to re-enable.
Raj: that means we have a gap in audit trail for ~07:58-08:20. not great.
Carlos: short-term mitigation ideas? can we bootstrap nodes with a fallback token cached in SSM?
Maya R: we have a cached artifact on warm nodes but new nodes expect fresh tokens. if we mint a short-lived golden token bound to caller IPs, they could complete bootstrap.
Ben P: doing that now — creating a one-hour orphan token scoped to prior policy paths. commands I'm running (dry-run first):
```
vault policy write prod-agent-fallback - <<EOF
path "secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
EOF
vault token create -policy=prod-agent-fallback -orphan -ttl=1h
```
Steve (security): please record the exception request. I'll open emergency exception for rotation plan and note the audit gap. compliance needs an owner for postmortem.
Maya R: Ben — confirm when token is created and where you uploaded the associated secret.
Ben P: token created and injected into k8s secret infra/fallback-bootstrap-token (encrypted). I also annotated the change in the rotation runbook. nodes are starting to pull artifacts now.
Carlos: seeing bootstraps succeed, GPUs are joining warm pools slowly. autoscaler still has pending pods but healing.
Raj: cost alert downgraded at 08:45. still higher than baseline but trending down.
Nina (compliance): good — please snapshot what audit data we do have and file a mitigation note. I'll coordinate with security on what to disclose in compliance report.
Steve (security): follow-ups: (1) add artifact-service role smoke test to rotation playbook, (2) gate vault rollouts with an automated policy-diff validator that runs against a service-mapping matrix, (3) ensure audit-shipper toggles require two-person approval in the runbook.
Maya R: adding owners and creating PLT ticket PLT-5120 for the playbook updates.
Raj: also propose we add a canary step that brings up a single boot node and validates keystore access before global rollout.
Ben P: agreed. I'll revert the policy change to prior state and then generate a staged rollout with the canary.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0312-VAULT-RL. Linked tickets: PLT-5120, COMPL-204.
Maya R: thanks all — closing once cost stabilizes and warm pools are healthy.
